summary.text: David Weeks is a Democratic member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 51, who assumed office in 2000 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an attorney who previously served as municipal court judge of Timmonsville, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Weeks attended Morris College's School of Religion and earned a B.A. from Morris College in 1975, a J.D. from the University of South Carolina in 1989 and an M.Ed. from Howard University in 1996.
He served as municipal court judge of Timmonsville from 1996 to 2000 and as chair of the Sumter City/County Planning Committee from 1998 to 2000, and he is currently an attorney.
Weeks first assumed office in the South Carolina House in 2000.
Ballotpedia lists him on the House Ethics Committee and the Ways and Means Committee for the 2025-2026 session, and as vice chair of the Ethics Committee in 2023-2024.
